name: Fab Lab Bali
blurb: A digital fabrication and prototyping facility in Bali aimed to empower the local community to develop meaningful interventions that enrich, empower, and scale Bali’s emerging regenerative economy.
description:
Fab Lab Bali is a cutting-edge digital fabrication and prototyping facility located in Jimbaran Hub, Bali that provides an extensive range of services to businesses, entrepreneurs, educational institutions, and individual makers in the region. 

Powered by the expertise of Meaningful Design Group, the eco-friendly vision of Jimbaran Hijau, and the full-support from Fab City Foundation, Fab Lab Bali aims to be a community innovation lab to propose and develop meaningful interventions that enrich, empower, and scale Bali’s emerging regenerative economy

Our mission is to empower the local community by offering access to state-of-the-art tools, technology, and training while fostering sustainable design principles and practices. We are committed to making a positive impact on the environment and nurturing a vibrant ecosystem of innovation, collaboration, and growth.

name: THCSLUONGKHANHTHIEN_HAIPHONG
blurb: A STEM classroom is an educational space designed for students to learn and engage in hands-on practice through an integrated approach to Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics.
description:
A STEM classroom is an educational space designed for students to learn and engage in hands-on practice through an integrated approach to Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics.
STEM Classroom
•	Provides an environment for students to practice, conduct experiments, and build prototypes.
•	Fosters logical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
•	Develops teamwork, communication, and presentation skills.
•	Connects theoretical knowledge with real-world situations.
STEM classrooms should be flexible and safe. Furniture should be movable to allow for transitions between individual study, group work, and project-based activities. Electrical, plumbing, and ventilation systems, as well as equipment areas, must be arranged to suit the students' age group.
Operational Model:
A STEM lesson typically follows this process:
Defining the problem → Acquiring knowledge → Proposing solutions → Designing/building → Testing → Improving → Presenting the product.
A STEM classroom is not merely a room filled with modern equipment. Most importantly, the space, equipment, and teaching methods must support students in self-discovery, hands-on practice, collaboration, and solving real-world problems.

name: Satbayev University
blurb: Open digital fabrication and advanced manufacturing lab supporting education, research, prototyping, employability and industry collaboration in Kazakhstan.
description:
abLab Satbayev University is an open digital fabrication and advanced manufacturing laboratory located in Almaty, Kazakhstan.

We support students, researchers, educators, startups and industry partners in transforming ideas into prototypes, functional products and applied engineering solutions. Our capabilities include 3D modelling and scanning, additive manufacturing, CNC milling and turning, laser and waterjet cutting, electronics, CAD/CAM/CAE, metrology and engineering training.

The laboratory develops industry-aligned micro-qualifications in 3D Modelling, Prototyping and CNC Machine Operation. These programmes combine practical training, digital manufacturing technologies and skills validated through cooperation with industrial and international partners.

FabLab Satbayev University participates in international educational and innovation initiatives and contributes to the global Fab Lab community. Our work primarily supports SDG 4 — Quality Education, SDG 8 — Decent Work and Economic Growth, SDG 9 — Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure, and SDG 17 — Partnerships for the Goals.

name: THCS Quang Trung_Tan Phu_Dong Nai
blurb: Sponsored by PetroVietnam, Quang Trung STEMLab is a high-tech makerspace with 3D printers, Robotics, and AI. We empower students to solve real-world problems and nurture future digital innovators.
description:
Welcome to Quang Trung STEMLab!
Proudly sponsored by the "STEM Innovation PetroVietnam" program, Quang Trung STEMLab is a state-of-the-art makerspace where creativity meets cutting-edge technology. Officially inaugurated on January 28, 2026, our lab empowers students from grades 6 to 9 to transform their bold ideas into reality.
Step inside and explore a world of innovation! The lab is fully equipped with advanced Anycubic 3D printers, versatile Snapmaker 3-in-1 Laser/CNC machines, and a network of modern ASUS ExpertBook laptops. Students can dive deep into the future by building and programming VEX Robotics (IQ & V5), developing Internet of Things (IoT) systems like weather stations, and mastering Artificial Intelligence using UNIHIKER K10 boards and HuskyLens AI smart cameras.
Guided by the Socratic method—"Ask to inspire, do not answer for them"—we foster independent thinking and a human-centered AI mindset. Our unique 4-step learning cycle (Engage, Experience, Challenge, Improve) ensures highly interactive and practical sessions. Here, students apply digital literacy and technology ethically to solve real-world problems and confidently prepare for national scientific competitions like VISEF.
Quang Trung STEMLab: The launchpad for tomorrow's innovators!

name: riidl Fablab
blurb: Research Innovation Incubation Design Laboratory Foundation (riidl Somaiya Vidyavihar) is an innovation center and a Tech Business Incubator in the Somaiya Campus.
description:
riidl FabLab – Empowering Innovation Through Digital Fabrication

riidl FabLab, housed within riidl Somaiya Vidyavihar, is a cutting-edge digital fabrication and prototyping facility designed to support students, makers, innovators, and startups in transforming their ideas into reality. Established as part of riidl (Research Innovation Incubation Design Laboratory Foundation), a nationally recognized business incubator, the FabLab plays a crucial role in fostering innovation, entrepreneurship, and hands-on learning on the Somaiya Vidyavihar campus and beyond.

Equipped with advanced 3D printers, CNC machines, laser cutters, electronics workstations, and fabrication tools, the lab provides resources for rapid prototyping, product development, and technical experimentation. As an active Fab Academy node, riidl FabLab has been training individuals in digital fabrication, embedded systems, and mechanical-electronics integration for the past several years. Regular rapid prototyping workshops and hands-on training sessions ensure that users gain expertise in computer-aided design (CAD), electronics fabrication, and interdisciplinary prototyping.

As a core facility supporting riidl’s incubation programs, the FabLab enables startups incubated at riidl to prototype, iterate, and develop scalable products. Through the Innovate PBL program, student innovators can receive mentorship and funding of up to ₹5 lakh to bring their projects to life. Additionally, the FabLab is open to small MSMEs and independent makers through dedicated membership plans, providing access to high-end fabrication tools and technical guidance.

riidl Somaiya Vidyavihar, recognized as a DST and DBT-BIRAC-supported business incubator, has incubated over 160 startups, facilitated the creation of 600+ jobs, and contributed to a startup ecosystem valued at over ₹1,226 Cr. The FabLab remains a key enabler in this journey, ensuring that emerging ventures and innovators have the technical infrastructure, expertise, and support to turn their ideas into market-ready solutions.

With its commitment to digital fabrication, entrepreneurship, and skill development, riidl FabLab continues to be a hub for prototyping, research, and innovation, empowering the next generation of creators to push the boundaries of technology and design.
address_1: 520, riidl HQ, Bhaskaracharya Building, Somaiya Vidyavihar Campus
address_notes: riidl HQ is located on the 5th floor above the library in the New building of K.J.Somaiya college of Engineering. You can come either from vidyavihar (railway) or ghatkopar(railway/metro station) and ask for Somayia Vidyavihar campus.

name: SEDI-Cup-ct
blurb: SEDI-Cup-ct FabLab offers different digital manufacturing technologies so that anyone can materialize their ideas and projects.
description:
It is a FabLab born in the heart of the Polytechnic University of Cartagena. Coordinated by the SEDIC, Industrial Design and Scientific Calculation Service, integrated into the SAIT, Technological Research Support Service. This central service offers services to different research groups, departments, students, public or private companies and external staff within the scope of the university. 
The FabLab aims to facilitate access to these services to all potential users outside or not the university community to develop and materialize their ideas and projects.
 SEDI-Cup-ct will make available to users the different digital manufacturing technologies (large format printing, 3D scanning, additive manufacturing, laser cutting, CNC machining, electronic workshop, ...). In addition, SEDI-Cup-ct gives access to training and workshops oriented to these technologies, and informative activities to promote the approach of society to the FabLab network.
